note: Curated for the owner's MuestraLibrary (kits/<pack>/... layout). NOBODY HAS LISTENED TO THESE: members were picked from measured features (unclipped, sensible level, tight decays, tuned kicks) and source reputation (REPORT.md section 2). Audition before committing; swap members by editing this file (copy it next to the samples as starter-kits.json). Levels differ between packs: set gain_db per lane. Each kit has named patterns (basic, busy, fill, phrase): library.kits pattern=<name> returns one ready to paste; crash only at the start of a phrase.

disco-01.description: 909-style four-on-the-floor kit: tight punchy kick, 909 clap on 2 & 4, metallic hats, off-beat open hat, cowbell, crash. Follows REPORT.md section 2.
disco-01.notes: Kick: 0.26 s, ~62 Hz (B1), 96 ms decay, peak -0.1 dBFS (hot; trim ~2 dB). Longer 909 boom alternative: roland-tr-8/kick-tr-8-kick-03.wav. Snare alternative for the backbeat: essential-kits-musicradar/tr-909-kit/snare-tr-909-snare-01.wav. The TR-8 is a 909/808-modelled hardware unit, not a vintage 909.

basic.description: Four-on-the-floor: bombo en negras, clap en 2 y 4, hat abierto a contratiempo, hat cerrado suave. Sin crash ni cencerro.

busy.description: Más movimiento: hats cerrados en semicorcheas con fantasmas, cencerro suave al final del compás.

fill.description: Compás de remate (el último antes de una parte nueva): bombo y clap empujan al final, los hats se cortan en el 4.

phrase.description: Frase de 4 compases con un crash solo en el uno del primer compás (pegalo donde empieza cada parte).

disco-808.description: 808 flavour: short tuned 808 kick, tight 808 clap, 808 hats, cowbell and conga for the disco-percussion glue.
disco-808.notes: Kick: ~60 Hz (B1), 185 ms decay, peak -5.8 dBFS (headroom; raise gain_db). The long 808 booms are kick-e808-bd-long-*.wav. This pack is multi-sampled: many sibling takes exist per voice (search kit='tr808').

basic.description: Four-on-the-floor 808: bombo en negras, clap en 2 y 4, hat abierto a contratiempo, hat cerrado suave.

busy.description: Con percusión disco: conga sincopada y cencerro suave, hats en semicorcheas.

fill.description: Remate: clap doble al final y conga que sube; hats cortados en el 4.

city-pop-80s.description: 80s pop / LinnDrum-era feel: deep kick, gated-reverb snare layered with a clap, bright digital hats, toms for fills. (LinnDrum-ERA aesthetic from the SampleRadar 80s pack; it is NOT actual LinnDrum samples.)
city-pop-80s.notes: Kick: ~37 Hz fundamental (very deep, peak -0.25 dBFS: hot, trim). Hats and shaker peak around -7 to -11 dBFS: raise their gain_db. The tom lane has silent default steps; program fills yourself. 31 more gated snares live in kits/80s-pop-drums/gated-snares/.

basic.description: Four-on-the-floor con caja gated y clap juntos en 2 y 4, hat abierto a contratiempo, hat cerrado suave.

busy.description: Más empuje: hats en semicorcheas y shaker suave en todas las semicorcheas.

fill.description: Remate ochentoso: toms en el 4 y caja doble; el bombo sigue en negras.

acoustic-disco.description: Dry close-miked acoustic kit for a live Studio-54 feel: short tight kick, snare backbeat, crisp hats, tambourine and a crash.
acoustic-disco.notes: Kick: ~59 Hz, 110 ms decay, peak -4.4 dBFS. Acoustic hits in this pack are generally quiet (many peak below -12 dBFS; these were picked for peaks above -7 dBFS). Mixed from two packs, so expect level/room differences. The REPORT's 909 disco-01 under a live kick is another option.

basic.description: Disco tocado: bombo en negras, caja en 2 y 4, hat abierto a contratiempo, hat cerrado suave. Sin crash ni pandereta.

busy.description: Con pandereta en 2 y 4 y hats en semicorcheas.

fill.description: Remate: caja en semicorcheas en el último tiempo, hats cortados.

phrase.description: Frase de 4 compases con un crash solo en el uno del primer compás.
